old_problem: `nvqual -h | head` neither runs nor proves the ConnectX/BlueField thermal test, and its insecure SSH pattern is unacceptable. No load, duration, ambient/cooling, sensor mapping, quantitative limits, fabric-health oracle or cooldown was defined.
disposition_reason: The device-class thermal objective is identifiable. Licensed recipe, topology/load, environmental conditions, sensor provenance, approved limits and cooldown/recovery are runtime Project Configuration. Static review can be complete while PASS remains blocked until quantitative limits exist; insecure placeholder access is rejected rather than promoted.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2125, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2126 / Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00003-V002 / 554342833c35c78e was directly read from XLSX and manifest.

The case is the licensed NT.3 ConnectX/BlueField thermal workload, not NVQual help output; preserve full thermal/network coverage and the 30/180-minute source allocation without treating it as an invented load duration.
Bind DPU/NIC/port/peer/fabric/cable/optics identities, traffic direction/rate/phases, actual duration, ambient/cooling state and every temperature/power/throttling sensor to one configuration hash.
Use authenticated trusted access and complete raw artifacts; plaintext sshpass, host-key bypass and `head` truncation are prohibited.
Define signed temperature, power, throttling, packet-loss, link/fabric-error and health limits before execution. No PASS can be issued while thresholds are absent.
Synchronize load phase with sensor, traffic, link, OS/BMC and cooling time series; stop at first limit, sensor loss, link/fabric fault, DPU/host instability, evidence gap or cooling anomaly.
Cease traffic, preserve first-fault evidence, perform signed cooldown/restoration and never disable protections, extend load or retry automatically.
No NVQual, network traffic, thermal stress, sensor query, interface change, cooldown, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.test_name: Interlocked ConnectX/BlueField NVQual NT.3 thermal-network qualification
test_case.purpose: Run the approved NVQual NT.3 workload on the mapped ConnectX/BlueField fabric and prove thermal, power, throttling, traffic/link integrity and device/host health remain within signed limits under defined load, duration, ambient and cooling.
required_package: Licensed pinned NVQual NT.3 package/configuration with compatible firmware/DOCA/driver
Signed DPU/NIC/port/peer/fabric/cable/optics and sensor identity map
Approved traffic/load phases/rates/direction/duration, ambient/cooling and sampling/stabilization rules
Isolated fabric/SUT, trusted authenticated access, independent monitoring, cooldown and recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration and quantitative limits are signed. Using trusted authenticated access, preserve baseline device/fabric/sensor/OS/BMC evidence; after point approval execute only the pinned NT.3 phases while recording synchronized load, traffic, temperatures, power, throttling, link/fabric errors, ambient/cooling and platform health. Stop at the first limit, sensor or evidence fault; cease traffic and run approved cooldown. Do not truncate, bypass protections or retry.
test_case.expected_result: Every approved phase completes for the specified rate and duration with correctly bound sensors, all signed thermal/power/throttling/network/health limits satisfied, no disqualifying device/host/fabric instability, and final temperature, interface policy and health restored after cooldown.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until recipe/topology/load/environment/sensors and quantitative limits are approved. PASS then requires complete synchronized evidence within every signed limit. FAIL on first limit breach, sensor loss/misbinding, packet/link/fabric error, cooling fault, DPU/host instability or failed restoration. Missing input/threshold/artifact is BLOCKED; retries cannot erase failure.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until licensed recipe, exact topology/load/environment/sensor map, quantitative limits, independent stop and cooldown/recovery are signed.
Reject plaintext credentials, host-key bypass, truncated output and any protection disablement.
Use an approved isolated fabric with verified cooling, stable power and emergency stop.
Stop traffic at first unsafe trend or evidence loss and never extend/retry automatically.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, approval, licensed NVQual version/configuration hash and secure-access audit
Load phases/rates/direction/duration, ambient/cooling, sample cadence and signed limit contract
Complete synchronized temperatures, power, throttling, traffic, loss, link/fabric errors, raw NVQual results and timestamps
OS/BMC/device logs, independent monitor and first-limit/abort/cooldown/restoration artifacts
Clean final interface/device/host health or quarantined first-fault state, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: At the first limit breach, sensor loss, fabric/link error, DPU/host instability, cooling/power anomaly or evidence gap, stop traffic and preserve the timeline. Apply only the signed cooldown and interface/policy restoration; do not restart load, and quarantine if temperatures or device/fabric health do not recover.
